'''Rarkgah''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Weequay/Legends|Weequay]] who lived on the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. During the war he held the rank of [[Chief of Security/Legends|Security Chief]] for the [[Red Light Sector (Nar Shaddaa)|Red Light Sector]] where the [[Bleeder]] gang were active. Fearing the gang had grown too powerful and that the [[Hutt Cartel/Legends|Hutt Cartel]] was doing nothing about it, Rarkgah asked a Republic-aligned individual to travel into the sector and activate a [[Merchant/Legends|merchant]] [[Turret/Legends|turret]] to hold off the Bleeders.
